## Checklist

- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`, DCO) and follows Conventional Commits
- [ ] Tests added or updated, and `flutter test` passes
- [ ] `dart format .` and `flutter analyze` report nothing
- [ ] New source files start with the SPDX header (`dart run tool/check_spdx.dart`)
- [ ] User-visible texts are in the ARB files, in Italian and English
- [ ] `docs/PRD.md` and `docs/DECISIONS.md` updated if a decision or a requirement changed
- [ ] No new dependency, or its licence, platforms and maintenance are reported above
- [ ] No secrets, personal data or telemetry
